description.narrative: The Activist Lab supports the dream of a new generation of changemakers. It is an initiative to help young, courageous activists worldwide to learn (the Academy), feel safe (the Shelter) and connect by action (the Movement) to achieve impact together. Ata time when fundamental changes are so urgently needed and changemakers are under pressure, connecting activists is at the core of this project. The project will focus around the topics of climate change and inequality. The project partners will work withyouth that are already engaged around the UN Climate Change Conference of the Parties (COP26, November 2021 in Glasgow) and the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2022 (January 2022 in Davos-Klosters). In The Netherlands the project will focus on ClimateChange and LGBTQI and organize at least 1 campaign lab.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
